decisions.reason: The MMAK modular concept is central to the firm's announced modular, environmental-technology direction and is publicly backed by a quantified customer success story, so management stays committed to it.
This slow-speed shredder has kept a dedicated page for two years, sits at the core of the firm's established offer and has absorbed development investment, so dropping it is unlikely.
The firm showcases this MMAK concept with a named reference customer and documented savings, which makes it a visible flagship it will defend.
This newly launched shredder line with its own page has just absorbed investment, and any weak early results would be attributed to the ramp-up phase.

The spiral shaft screen is a recent launch that supports the firm's modular processing strategy, and the firm has only just committed to it publicly, although the earlier withdrawal of its trommel screen shows screens are less sacrosanct.
